name: PolyAI
positioning: An enterprise conversational platform that builds and runs voice (and chat) agents on its own dialog models for large customer-service operations.

pricing.model: Per-minute, rates not published; contact sales form
pricing.headline: Priced per minute of agent use, including performance improvements, maintenance and 24/7 support; no rate is published.
planNotes: The pricing page says ongoing use is 'priced on a per-minute basis' including proactive performance improvements, maintenance and 24/7 support.
The page shows a contact form instead of a rate card.
whatIsExtra: Not stated on the page (implementation or build fees are not described).

strengths.claim: Vendor states certifications: SOC 2+ Type 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS and GDPR.
Runs on its own audio-native dialog models; the homepage cites under 300ms production latency for its flagship model.
130+ integrations, a self-serve Connect Portal and an Agent Developer Kit (ADK) for programmatic control.
Per-minute pricing bundles maintenance, ongoing improvement and 24/7 support.
Vendor reports large-scale deployments (for example 1M calls a month for one healthcare customer).

limitations.claim: Pricing is not published; the pricing page directs visitors to a form.

compliance.note: Stated by vendor, self-attested on the homepage: 'SOC 2+ Type 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR'. The security page also states ISO 27001 certification. No HIPAA statement found on the pages read.

telephony.providedNumbers: Not stated; the integration catalog lists a 'Telephony and voice routing' category and the security page lists Twilio and Five9 among integrations.

bestFor: Large enterprises with high call volumes that want a vendor-managed, deeply integrated voice agent program.
unknowns: Minimums, contract length and implementation fees
Agent export or data portability terms
